adjudication.rationale: Looking at the Office365CalendarService.ts diff, the createEvent method extracts `[mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` and uses `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId` to determine the calendar URL. Unlike GoogleCalendarService which receives `credentialId` as a parameter and uses `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` to select the correct calendar for each credential, Office365CalendarService always uses the first destination calendar regardless of which credential is calling it. For collective team events where multiple hosts have different destination calendars, this means all Office 365 hosts would target the first host's calendar instead of their own.
